title: Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Theme 9: Magonjwa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the setting by its place and purpose, then speaks in standard Kiswahili with titles, politeness and turn-taking.
representations: setting cards: clinic, office, assembly, home
a mock meeting with a chair
steps: Who is the official, and his title?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child acts a clinic visit telling the symptoms clearly.

misconceptions.ask: Mahali hapa ni pa kazi rasmi?
misconceptions.repair: Muktadha rasmi una kazi maalum na mahali rasmi: kliniki, ofisi, mkutano.

listen_for: Niko poa tu daktari, ni ka-homa.
misconceptions.repair: Kwa daktari tunaeleza wazi kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
Katika muktadha rasmi tunatumia cheo: Mwalimu Mkuu, Daktari.

listen_for: uliza mara moja hata kama mwenzako anazungumza
misconceptions.repair: Katika mkutano rasmi, omba nafasi kabla ya kuzungumza.

checks.question: Ni muktadha upi ni rasmi: harusi ya binamu, mkutano wa wazazi shuleni?
